definitions.explanation: The yellow, nutrient-rich center of an egg. Used in cooking and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {卵黄|らんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
カルボナーラ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卵黄|らんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Egg yolk is used for carbonara.

examples.japanese: {卵黄|らんおう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧や⟦ミネラル→ミネラル：23090_mineraru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}んでいる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Egg yolks are rich in nutrients and contain many vitamins and minerals.

notes:
{卵黄|らんおう} is the formal/technical term for egg yolk. Composed of {卵|らん} (egg) + {黄|おう} (yellow).

REGISTER:
The everyday term is {黄身|きみ} (lit. "yellow part"). {卵黄|らんおう} is used in recipes, food labels, nutritional information, and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵黄|らんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: add egg yolk
- {卵黄|らんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: mix in egg yolk
- {卵黄|らんおう}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: egg yolk sauce
- {卵黄|らんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: separate the yolk

PAIR:
- {卵黄|らんおう}: egg yolk
- ⟦{卵白|らんぱく}→卵白：11975_ranpaku⟧: egg white

The casual equivalents are {黄身|きみ} (yolk) and ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧ (white).
